All Countries Invaded by Britain 🇬🇧

Historians count 171 — nine of every ten nations on Earth. Here are 94 present-day countries where British troops actually set foot: colonies, invasions, and raids across every continent. From Canada to Australia, Iceland to Argentina, India to Egypt.

So… did Britain invade your country too? 👇

Sources: S. Laycock, "All the Countries We've Ever Invaded"; Wikipedia — wars involving the United Kingdom. Present-day borders.
